s0301.literal: They also said: "For this summer's court assembly at Shangdu's provisioning, we request one million ingots of notes be issued in advance."
s0301.idiomatic: They also said, "For this summer's court assembly at Shangdu's provisioning, we request 1 million ingots of notes be issued in advance."

s0303.literal: The registered households under Prince of Chu Yahu were impoverished; ten thousand shi of rice and six thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0303.idiomatic: The registered households under Prince of Chu Yahu were impoverished; 10,000 shi of rice and 6,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0304.literal: On jisi day Prince of Ning Kuokuochu plotted sedition; Prince of Yue Tula's son Alana Shili promised to assist; when the plot was discovered, Kuokuochu was imprisoned; his wife Wanji was granted death; Alana Shili together with his grandmother, mother, and wife were banished to Botemür's custody.
s0304.idiomatic: On jisi day Prince of Ning Kuokuochu plotted sedition; Prince of Yue Tula's son Alana Shili promised to assist; when the plot was discovered, Kuokuochu was imprisoned; his wife Wanji was granted death; Alana Shili together with his grandmother, mother, and wife were banished to Botemür's custody.

s0305.literal: Because twenty-four persons including the Uighur monk Tieli had conspired together, or knew of the plot yet did not report it, all were dismembered in the marketplace;
s0305.idiomatic: Because 24 persons including the Uighur monk Tieli had conspired together, or knew of the plot yet did not report it, all were dismembered in the marketplace;

s0306.literal: those who tried the case were all promoted two ranks.
s0306.idiomatic: those who tried the case were all promoted two ranks.

s0307.literal: Yahu was rewarded with one thousand taels of gold and seven thousand five hundred taels of silver.
s0307.idiomatic: Yahu was rewarded with 1,000 taels of gold and 7,500 taels of silver.

s0308.literal: Sanbaonu was granted the title Darqan; Kuokuochu's Qingzhou fief was granted to him; from the darughachi downward, all were permitted to recommend appointments.
s0308.idiomatic: Sanbaonu was granted the title Darqan; Kuokuochu's Qingzhou fief was granted to him; from the darughachi downward, all were permitted to recommend appointments.

s0309.literal: On xinwei day Toerchiyan was further made recorder of state affairs of military importance; the wife of the late right chancellor of the central secretariat Talahai, Yerigan, was granted seven hundred fifty taels of gold, one thousand five hundred taels of silver, and four hundred ingots of notes.
s0309.idiomatic: On xinwei day Toerchiyan was further made recorder of state affairs of military importance; the wife of the late right chancellor of the central secretariat Talahai, Yerigan, was granted 750 taels of gold, 1,500 taels of silver, and 400 ingots of notes.

s0310.literal: On renshen day Leshi was made left chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue and imperial son-in-law commandant, and enfeoffed Duke of Qi State.
s0310.idiomatic: On renshen day Leshi was made left chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue and imperial son-in-law commandant, and enfeoffed Duke of Qi State.

s0311.literal: On guiyou day left chancellor and acting branch secretariat pingzhang Hesan Shang was assigned to deliberate on Liaoyang branch secretariat affairs.
s0311.idiomatic: On guiyou day left chancellor and acting branch secretariat pingzhang Hesan Shang was assigned to deliberate on Liaoyang branch secretariat affairs.

s0312.literal: On yihai day Venus transgressed the moon.
s0312.idiomatic: On yihai day Venus transgressed the moon.

s0313.literal: With the empress dowager's honorific title, an announcement was made at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0313.idiomatic: With the empress dowager's honorific title, an announcement was made at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0314.literal: Third month, jimao new moon: privy council officials said: "The state establishes offices with divided duties; the overall secretariat governs revenue and grain, the privy council governs military affairs — each has fixed regulations.
s0314.idiomatic: Third month, jimao new moon: privy council officials said, "The state establishes offices with divided duties; the overall secretariat governs revenue and grain, the privy council governs military affairs — each has fixed regulations.

s0315.literal: Recently the Ministry of Revenue did not follow the established statutes and reshuffled this bureau's offices; we request they report according to the Dade tenth year personnel quota.
s0315.idiomatic: Recently the Ministry of Revenue did not follow the established statutes and reshuffled this bureau's offices; we request they report according to the Dade tenth year personnel quota.

s0316.literal: We your ministers propose Temür Buqa, Toerchiyan, Chuangwu'er, Yesu, Toghto, and Yierjini as privy council directors; Tobuhua as Metropolitan privy council director; Sadi Shishi and Shi Bi as associate privy council directors; Wu Yuangui as privy council vice director; and Tahai Gu as vice privy council director.
s0316.idiomatic: We your ministers propose Temür Buqa, Toerchiyan, Chuangwu'er, Yesu, Toghto, and Yierjini as privy council directors; Tobuhua as Metropolitan privy council director; Sadi Shishi and Shi Bi as associate privy council directors; Wu Yuangui as privy council vice director; and Tahai Gu as vice privy council director.

s0317.literal: An order stated: "Let the privy council establish seventeen posts according to the old system."
s0317.idiomatic: An order stated, "Let the privy council establish 17 posts according to the old system."

s0318.literal: On yiyou day privy council director Jirhelang was made pingzhang of the Shaanxi branch Ministry of Revenue.
s0318.idiomatic: On yiyou day privy council director Jirhelang was made pingzhang of the Shaanxi branch Ministry of Revenue.

s0319.literal: The Minister of Justice Ma'er was dispatched to Gansu to purchase sheep and horses by negotiated sale; rewards were distributed to Prince Namuhuli's Mongol army; seventy thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0319.idiomatic: The Minister of Justice Ma'er was dispatched to Gansu to purchase sheep and horses by negotiated sale; rewards were distributed to Prince Namuhuli's Mongol army; 70,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0320.literal: On gengyin day the moon transgressed Di.
s0320.idiomatic: On gengyin day the moon transgressed Di.

s0321.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Formerly Shizu issued an order that the five-household silk tribute from rebel prince Qaidu's allotted lands be kept as currency silks, to be granted when they came to surrender — stored for more than twenty years.
s0321.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Formerly Shizu issued an order that the five-household silk tribute from rebel prince Qaidu's allotted lands be kept as currency silks, to be granted when they came to surrender — stored for more than 20 years.

s0322.literal: Now his son Chapar, admiring our civilizing influence, has come to court in homage; we request it be granted to him.
s0322.idiomatic: Now his son Chapar, admiring our civilizing influence, has come to court in homage; we request it be granted to him.

s0323.literal: The Emperor said: "Shizu's forethought was so far-reaching; wait until the princes' court assembly, and once the distribution of rewards is complete, you shall fully explain the reason, then give it to them — so they will know shame.
s0323.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Shizu's forethought was so far-reaching; wait until the princes' court assembly, and once the distribution of rewards is complete, you shall fully explain the reason, then give it to them — so they will know shame.

s0324.literal: On xinmao day Kangli army garrison-farm troops were sent to Yongping; oxen were supplied by the government.
s0324.idiomatic: On xinmao day Kangli army garrison-farm troops were sent to Yongping; oxen were supplied by the government.

s0325.literal: On renchen day the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.
s0325.idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.

s0326.literal: The Xingsheng Palace Zhangqing Bureau was established, primary second grade.
s0326.idiomatic: The Xingsheng Palace Zhangqing Bureau was established, primary second grade.

s0327.literal: On bingshen day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
s0327.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

s0328.literal: On dingwei day Venus transgressed Jing.
s0328.idiomatic: On dingwei day Venus transgressed Jing.

s0329.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day 4,000 households of the Xingsheng Palace falconry office and others were distributed to Liaoyang; a wanhu office was established to administer them.

s0330.literal: Rongmi Cave official Tian Mo gathered barbarian chiefs, killed a qianhu and more than eighty garrison soldiers, and captured and plundered common people;
s0330.idiomatic: Rongmi Cave official Tian Mo gathered barbarian chiefs, killed a qianhu and more than 80 garrison soldiers, and captured and plundered common people;

s0331.literal: the Yongshun Baojing Nanwei Pacification Commission was changed to the Yongshun and other places military-civilian pacification commission; vice pacification commissioner Zicai was made pacification commissioner and dispatched to summon them.
s0331.idiomatic: the Yongshun Baojing Nanwei Pacification Commission was changed to the Yongshun and other places military-civilian pacification commission; vice pacification commissioner Zicai was made pacification commissioner and dispatched to summon them.

s0332.idiomatic: The Goryeo king Wang Zhang was granted a merit-title; his enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Shen.

s0333.literal: The Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple overall administration office was changed to the Chongxiang Directorate.
s0333.idiomatic: The Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple overall administration office was changed to the Chongxiang Directorate.

s0334.literal: On gengxu day nine thousand one hundred fifty-eight-odd ingots of notes were used to purchase plow oxen and farm implements for the Zhigu Suanzaolin garrison-farm troops.
s0334.idiomatic: On gengxu day 9,158-odd ingots of notes were used to purchase plow oxen and farm implements for the Zhigu Suanzaolin garrison-farm troops.

s0335.literal: On wuchen day Venus was visible in daytime.
s0335.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus was visible in daytime.

s0336.literal: On jisi day the Qielian Household Various Artisans Overall Directorate was established, primary third grade; two intendant offices were set up administering Dadu and Shangdu separately, primary fifth grade;

s0337.literal: Jiang-Zhe and other places revenue intendant offices, secondary fifth grade;
s0337.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe and other places revenue intendant offices, secondary fifth grade;

s0338.literal: Ruizhou and other routes camp civilian overall intendant office, secondary fourth grade — all subordinate to the Zhangqing Bureau.
s0338.idiomatic: Ruizhou and other routes camp civilian overall intendant office, secondary fourth grade — all subordinate to the Zhangqing Bureau.

s0339.literal: On xinwei day the wrestler Ari was granted one thousand taels of silver and four hundred ingots of notes.
s0339.idiomatic: On xinwei day the wrestler Ari was granted 1,000 taels of silver and 400 ingots of notes.

s0340.literal: On bingzi day the Military Artisans Qianhu Office was established, primary fifth grade; eight hundred artisans of the Left Capital Weiguard were assigned to it to prepare for Xingsheng Palace construction.
s0340.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Military Artisans Qianhu Office was established, primary fifth grade; 800 artisans of the Left Capital Weiguard were assigned to it to prepare for Xingsheng Palace construction.

s0341.literal: Imperial Academy students were increased to three hundred places.
s0341.idiomatic: Imperial Academy students were increased to 300 places.

s0342.literal: Lingshou and Pingyin counties suffered hail; Yanshan, Ningjin, Tangyi, Chiping, Yanggu, Gaotang, Yucheng, and other counties suffered locusts.
s0342.idiomatic: Lingshou and Pingyin counties suffered hail; Yanshan, Ningjin, Tangyi, Chiping, Yanggu, Gaotang, Yucheng, and other counties suffered locusts.

s0343.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiashen day Prince Wanji was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.

s0344.literal: On guisi day the people of Dongping were famished; five thousand shi of rice were granted for relief.
s0344.idiomatic: On guisi day the people of Dongping were famished; 5,000 shi of rice were granted for relief.

s0345.literal: On yiwei day Ministry of Revenue associate administrator Wang Bi was further made Grand Preceptor.
s0345.idiomatic: On yiwei day Ministry of Revenue associate administrator Wang Bi was further made Grand Preceptor.

s0346.literal: That month, Hefei, Shucheng, Liyang, Mengcheng, Huoqiu, Huaining, and other counties suffered locusts.
s0346.idiomatic: That month, Hefei, Shucheng, Liyang, Mengcheng, Huoqiu, Huaining, and other counties suffered locusts.

s0347.literal: Sixth month, dingwei new moon: an edict directed Grand Preceptor and Ministry of Revenue right chancellor Tuohuotuo and Grand Guardian and Ministry of Revenue left chancellor Sanbaonu to oversee all bureaus' routine affairs; all were to be submitted through the Ministry of Revenue for implementation.
s0347.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingwei new moon: an edict directed Grand Preceptor and Ministry of Revenue right chancellor Tuohuotuo and Grand Guardian and Ministry of Revenue left chancellor Sanbaonu to oversee all bureaus' routine affairs; all were to be submitted through the Ministry of Revenue for implementation.

s0348.literal: On wushen day seven posts of the Shangdu chief administrator's office were cut.
s0348.idiomatic: On wushen day 7 posts of the Shangdu chief administrator's office were cut.

s0349.literal: Acting branch secretariat left associate administrator Hubududing was made central secretariat right associate administrator.
s0349.idiomatic: Acting branch secretariat left associate administrator Hubududing was made central secretariat right associate administrator.

s0350.literal: On jiyou day the Shangdu, Zhongdu, and other places silver smelting intendant office was established, primary fourth grade.
s0350.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Shangdu, Zhongdu, and other places silver smelting intendant office was established, primary fourth grade.

s0351.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Biedu Lusi reported that Chaohé and other places in Yunzhou produce silver; men were sent to test it and obtained six hundred fifty taels of silver.
s0351.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Biedu Lusi reported that Chaohé and other places in Yunzhou produce silver; men were sent to test it and obtained 650 taels of silver.

s0352.literal: An edict ordered establishment of an intendant office; Biedu Lusi was made darughachi.
s0352.idiomatic: An edict ordered establishment of an intendant office; Biedu Lusi was made darughachi.

s0353.literal: On gengxu day the Guiyun Overall Directorate was established, primary third grade, supervising the revenue and grain of Dachong'en Fuyuan Temple; intendant office, resources treasury, and Dayi Granary were established subordinate to it.
s0353.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Guiyun Overall Directorate was established, primary third grade, supervising the revenue and grain of Dachong'en Fuyuan Temple; intendant office, resources treasury, and Dayi Granary were established subordinate to it.

s0354.literal: On yimao day the moon transgressed Di.
s0354.idiomatic: On yimao day the moon transgressed Di.

s0355.literal: The Karakorum province reported: "Poor people coming from the far north — over four years have consumed six hundred thousand shi of grain, more than forty thousand ingots of notes, three thousand fishing nets, and twenty thousand farm implements.
s0355.idiomatic: The Karakorum province reported, "Poor people coming from the far north — over four years have consumed 600,000 shi of grain, more than 40,000 ingots of notes, 3,000 fishing nets, and 20,000 farm implements.

s0356.literal: An edict directed the Ministry of Revenue and privy council to dispatch officials to verify with Karakorum provincial officials, grant farm implements and seed, and enable them to farm for their food; for those continuing to arrive, grain was to be granted at the rate of four persons per household.
s0356.idiomatic: An edict directed the Ministry of Revenue and privy council to dispatch officials to verify with Karakorum provincial officials, grant farm implements and seed, and enable them to farm for their food; for those continuing to arrive, grain was to be granted at the rate of four persons per household.

s0357.literal: On dingsi day an order directed that this year's princes' and consorts' court assembly rewards follow the Zhida first year precedent.
s0357.idiomatic: On dingsi day an order directed that this year's princes' and consorts' court assembly rewards follow the Zhida first year precedent.

s0358.literal: On jiazi day crown prince household administrator Wochi was made central secretariat left associate administrator and Jixian commissioner, supervising the Medical Directorate.
s0358.idiomatic: On jiazi day crown prince household administrator Wochi was made central secretariat left associate administrator and Jixian commissioner, supervising the Medical Directorate.

s0359.literal: On wuchen day envoys were dispatched to all circuits to review and decide serious criminal cases.
s0359.idiomatic: On wuchen day envoys were dispatched to all circuits to review and decide serious criminal cases.

s0360.literal: Grand Preceptor Prince of Qiyang Yuechicha'er was granted seventeen thousand nine hundred nineteen Qingzhou civilian households; Prince of Anji Qitai Puji was granted five hundred Anji Prefecture civilian households.
s0360.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Prince of Qiyang Yuechicha'er was granted 17,919 Qingzhou civilian households; Prince of Anji Qitai Puji was granted 500 Anji Prefecture civilian households.

s0361.literal: On renshen day because northwestern princes Chapar and others came to court, an announcement was made at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0361.idiomatic: On renshen day because northwestern princes Chapar and others came to court, an announcement was made at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0362.literal: Tuohuotuo and Sanbaonu were granted pearl robes; Sanbaonu was enfeoffed Duke of Chu State, with Changzhou Route as appanage.
s0362.idiomatic: Tuohuotuo and Sanbaonu were granted pearl robes; Sanbaonu was enfeoffed Duke of Chu State, with Changzhou Route as appanage.

s0363.literal: On yihai day the Prince of Jin's Yanqing Bureau was raised to primary second grade.
s0363.idiomatic: On yihai day the Prince of Jin's Yanqing Bureau was raised to primary second grade.

s0364.idiomatic: That month, Xiangyang, Xizhou Route, and Jingmen Prefecture suffered great flooding; mountains collapsed; 21,829 government offices and dwellings were destroyed; 3,466 persons died.

s0365.idiomatic: Ruzhou suffered great flooding; 92 persons died.

s0366.literal: Lu'an Prefecture suffered great flooding; fifty-two persons died.
s0366.idiomatic: Lu'an Prefecture suffered great flooding; 52 persons died.

s0367.literal: Yizhou, Juzhou, Yanzhou, and various counties suffered flooding; civilian fields were submerged.
s0367.idiomatic: Yizhou, Juzhou, Yanzhou, and various counties suffered flooding; civilian fields were submerged.

s0368.idiomatic: Weizhou, Luoshui, Feixiang, Jize, and other counties suffered drought.

s0369.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day the moon transgressed Right Enforcer.
s0369.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day the moon transgressed Right Enforcer.

s0370.literal: On jimao day the moon transgressed Upper Minister.
s0370.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed Upper Minister.

s0371.literal: On gengchen day the eldest daughter of the Emperor's elder uncle Prince of Jin, Baodashi Lian, was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Han State.
s0371.idiomatic: On gengchen day the eldest daughter of the Emperor's elder uncle Prince of Jin, Baodashi Lian, was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Han State.

s0372.idiomatic: On bingxu day Xunzhou suffered great flooding; 244 dwellings were swept away; 43 persons died; rice was issued for relief.

s0374.idiomatic: Prince of Ding Yaomuhu'er requested 6 princely household officials per precedent; this was approved.

s0375.idiomatic: On guisi day performance-evaluation sealed registers were issued to close-to-the-people chief officials; supervisory officers were ordered to verify their conduct at year's end, record and report upward; the surveillance commission, censorate, and Ministry of Revenue Rites section were to evaluate for promotion or demotion.

s0376.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue reception commissioners and deputies were each increased by one post; direct secretariat attendants by 14 posts.

s0380.idiomatic: On jihai day powerful persons and merchants bearing imperial, empress dowager's, or consort's edicts to obstruct civilian boats on the Hui Tong Canal were forbidden.

s0382.idiomatic: Cizhou, Weizhou, and various counties suffered drought and locusts.
